title: BARE: Towards Bias-Aware and Reasoning-Enhanced One-Tower Visual Grounding

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the over-reliance on unimodal priors in visual grounding tasks by comparing vanilla one-tower architectures against a proposed bias-aware framework across various multimodal benchmarks.

Measuring the impact of frequency-based linguistic shortcuts and statistical correlations in text queries, evaluated by analyzing model performance on fine-grained difficulty splits (easy, medium, hard) and ablating a Language Salience Modulator.

Assessing the model's susceptibility to dominant object priors and deceptive visual associations by testing grounding accuracy in distractor-heavy and visually ambiguous scenarios, with and without a Visual Bias Correction module.
